people_wise_recipient_id_length.name: people_wise_recipient_id_length
people_wise_recipient_id_length.value: "people"."wise_recipient_id" is null or length("people"."wise_recipient_id") between 1 and 100

people_contact_lengths.name: people_contact_lengths
people_contact_lengths.value:
coalesce(length("people"."email"), 0) <= 320 and coalesce(length("people"."phone"), 0) <= 64
        and coalesce(length("people"."website"), 0) <= 2048 and coalesce(length("people"."linkedin"), 0) <= 2048
        and coalesce(length("people"."x"), 0) <= 2048 and coalesce(length("people"."other_contact"), 0) <= 500
